name: coco-lab-web
description: COCO Lab in the browser: renders coco_lab bundles and asks coco_lab (Pyodide) to recompute. It never implements a search.

scripts.dev: node tools/build_arena_assets.mjs && node tools/g1/bake_worlds.mjs && node tools/build_attract.mjs && node tools/build_v2_runs.mjs && vite
scripts.build: node tools/assets/build_design_assets.mjs --check && node tools/build_arena_assets.mjs && node tools/g1/bake_worlds.mjs && node tools/build_attract.mjs && node tools/build_v2_runs.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p . && vite build && node tools/build_service_worker.mjs
scripts.arena-assets: node tools/build_arena_assets.mjs && node tools/g1/bake_worlds.mjs && node tools/build_attract.mjs && node tools/build_v2_runs.mjs
